decision.justification: Two independent views of this merchant disagree with its declaration. The storefront presents a different business, and the scripts channel agrees. Neither could have produced the other: a merchant cannot change its payment behaviour without changing its actual business, and cannot change its interface without changing what customers see.
notes: The corroborating view is scripts rather than telemetry. This is the rented-account shape: the genuine store keeps trading, so the payment mixture stays near the category baseline and telemetry alone never crosses its threshold.

narrative.text: Merchant MID100064 declared apparel at onboarding 899 days ago. Telemetry agrees: the largest deviations from the apparel baseline are slope_log_volume at +6.2 sigma (observed 0.0141 against a category baseline of 0.00196), peak_ratio at +3.6 sigma (observed 2.44 against a category baseline of 1.54), chargeback_rate at +2.6 sigma (observed 0.00739 against a category baseline of 0.00289). The checkout surface presents a unlicensed_lending interface at 0.96 confidence, against a declared category of apparel. This vertical cannot be approved on this platform. Asked directly, the merchant restated its declared business. In total 2 independent views of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 5 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because confidence threshold met. Recommended tier restricts settlements, corroborated by the scripts channel; the storefront alone would not have been sufficient.
